profile.legalName: Catholic Charities Of The East Bay
profile.summary: A nonprofit that serves Alameda and Contra Costa counties in California. Its programs include housing services, mental health and wellness services, and immigration legal services. Its stated mission is to support children, youth, families and seniors from crisis to stability to well-being.
